title: hdheath/flair-eval pipeline parameters
description: Compare FLAIR runs (versions, branches or settings) on the same long-read data and write one self-contained HTML report.

file_mode.title: Inputs: config files
file_mode.description: Describe samples and FLAIR runs in files. See docs/CONTRACTS.md section 1.

input.description: samples.csv: one row per sample (sample, reads or bam, genome, gtf, [platform, library]).
input.help_text: Columns follow assets/schema/samples.schema.json. Relative paths resolve next to the CSV, then in the launch directory. Cannot be combined with --reads/--bam/--genome/--gtf/--sample/--platform/--library.

runs.description: runs.yaml: one entry per FLAIR run (id, flair source, transcriptome_args, ...).
runs.help_text: Each run gives exactly one FLAIR source: release, git (+ ref), env or container. Follows assets/schema/runs.schema.json. Cannot be combined with --flair.

one_command.title: Inputs: one command, no files
one_command.description: One sample and a list of FLAIR versions straight from the command line.

reads.description: Long reads (FASTQ/FASTA, may be gzipped) for a single sample.

bam.description: Sorted, indexed BAM for a single sample (skips the shared align step).
bam.help_text: The .bai must sit next to the BAM.

genome.description: Genome FASTA for the one-command sample.

gtf.description: Reference annotation GTF for the one-command sample.

sample.description: Sample name for the one-command sample (default: reads/BAM file name without extensions).

platform.description: Sequencing platform of the one-command sample.

library.description: Library type of the one-command sample.

flair.help_text: Tokens: 3.0.1 or release:3.0.1 -> run flair-3.0.1; dev, main or git:<ref> -> BrooksLabUCSC/flair at that ref, run flair-<ref>; git:<url>@<ref> -> run flair-<ref>; env:/path -> run env-<basename>; container:<uri> -> run ctr-<name>. Cannot be combined with --runs.

flair_args.description: Extra arguments appended to flair transcriptome/collapse for every --flair run.

outdir.description: Output directory: bundles/, report/report.html and pipeline_info/.
outdir.help_text: On PRISM put this on groups or warm-archive storage, not in home.

bundles.description: Comma-separated directories or globs of earlier bundles to add to the report.
bundles.help_text: Any folder that contains bundle.json files below it, e.g. an earlier <outdir>/bundles. When the same (sample, run_id) appears twice, the newest one wins.

baseline.description: Run id that report differences are computed against (default: the first run).

report_only.description: Skip all compute and build the report from --bundles only.

align_flair.description: FLAIR release used for the shared align step (once per sample).

regions.description: Optional BED: restrict assembly and evaluation to these regions.

env_cache.description: Where FLAIR environments are built and cached.
env_cache.help_text: Defaults to <launchDir>/flair-env-cache. On PRISM set it on groups storage.

help.description: Show this help message and exit.
